apps.title: Point of Sale
apps.summary: Verify a customer (sanctions or passport) then accept payment on any network.
apps.details: A merchant point-of-sale terminal. Enter an amount in fiat or crypto, verify the customer cross-device (a sanctions-clean Musnad credential within 12 months by default, or passport attributes), then receive payment on the network you choose (EVM, Bitcoin, Solana, or Tron) to an address from your address book, auto-detected on-chain. Keeps a receipt log with the fiat value at time of sale and a trusted badge.

capabilities.name: identity
capabilities.reason: Verify each customer holds a sanctions-clean credential

capabilities.name: payment
capabilities.reason: Receive payments and pick a receiving address
